blocks.source: Canto VII
blocks.translation: Canto VII

blocks.source: «Pape Satàn, pape Satàn aleppe!»,
blocks.translation: “Pape Satan, Pape Satan, Aleppe!”

blocks.source: cominciò Pluto con la voce chioccia;
blocks.translation: Thus Plutus with his clucking voice began;

blocks.source: e quel savio gentil, che tutto seppe,
blocks.translation: And that benignant Sage, who all things knew,

blocks.source: disse per confortarmi: «Non ti noccia
blocks.translation: Said, to encourage me: “Let not thy fear

blocks.source: la tua paura; ché, poder ch’elli abbia,
blocks.translation: Harm thee; for any power that he may have

blocks.source: non ci torrà lo scender questa roccia».
blocks.translation: Shall not prevent thy going down this crag.”

blocks.source: Poi si rivolse a quella ’nfiata labbia,
blocks.translation: Then he turned round unto that bloated lip,

blocks.source: e disse: «Taci, maladetto lupo!
blocks.translation: And said: “Be silent, thou accursed wolf;

blocks.source: consuma dentro te con la tua rabbia.
blocks.translation: Consume within thyself with thine own rage.

blocks.source: Non è sanza cagion l’andare al cupo:
blocks.translation: Not causeless is this journey to the abyss;

blocks.source: vuolsi ne l’alto, là dove Michele
blocks.translation: Thus is it willed on high, where Michael wrought

blocks.source: fé la vendetta del superbo strupo».
blocks.translation: Vengeance upon the proud adultery.”

blocks.source: Quali dal vento le gonfiate vele
blocks.translation: Even as the sails inflated by the wind

blocks.source: caggiono avvolte, poi che l’alber fiacca,
blocks.translation: Involved together fall when snaps the mast,

blocks.source: tal cadde a terra la fiera crudele.
blocks.translation: So fell the cruel monster to the earth.

blocks.source: Così scendemmo ne la quarta lacca,
blocks.translation: Thus we descended into the fourth chasm,

blocks.source: pigliando più de la dolente ripa
blocks.translation: Gaining still farther on the dolesome shore

blocks.source: che ’l mal de l’universo tutto insacca.
blocks.translation: Which all the woe of the universe insacks.

blocks.source: Ahi giustizia di Dio! tante chi stipa
blocks.translation: Justice of God, ah! who heaps up so many

blocks.source: nove travaglie e pene quant’ io viddi?
blocks.translation: New toils and sufferings as I beheld?

blocks.source: e perché nostra colpa sì ne scipa?
blocks.translation: And why doth our transgression waste us so?

blocks.source: Come fa l’onda là sovra Cariddi,
blocks.translation: As doth the billow there upon Charybdis,

blocks.source: che si frange con quella in cui s’intoppa,
blocks.translation: That breaks itself on that which it encounters,

blocks.source: così convien che qui la gente riddi.
blocks.translation: So here the folk must dance their roundelay.

blocks.source: Qui vid’ i’ gente più ch’altrove troppa,
blocks.translation: Here saw I people, more than elsewhere, many,

blocks.source: e d’una parte e d’altra, con grand’ urli,
blocks.translation: On one side and the other, with great howls,

blocks.source: voltando pesi per forza di poppa.
blocks.translation: Rolling weights forward by main force of chest.

blocks.source: Percotëansi ’ncontro; e poscia pur lì
blocks.translation: They clashed together, and then at that point

blocks.source: si rivolgea ciascun, voltando a retro,
blocks.translation: Each one turned backward, rolling retrograde,

blocks.source: gridando: «Perché tieni?» e «Perché burli?».
blocks.translation: Crying, “Why keepest?” and, “Why squanderest thou?”

blocks.source: Così tornavan per lo cerchio tetro
blocks.translation: Thus they returned along the lurid circle

blocks.source: da ogne mano a l’opposito punto,
blocks.translation: On either hand unto the opposite point,

blocks.source: gridandosi anche loro ontoso metro;
blocks.translation: Shouting their shameful metre evermore.

blocks.source: poi si volgea ciascun, quand’ era giunto,
blocks.translation: Then each, when he arrived there, wheeled about

blocks.source: per lo suo mezzo cerchio a l’altra giostra.
blocks.translation: Through his half-circle to another joust;

blocks.source: E io, ch’avea lo cor quasi compunto,
blocks.translation: And I, who had my heart pierced as it were,

blocks.source: dissi: «Maestro mio, or mi dimostra
blocks.translation: Exclaimed: “My Master, now declare to me

blocks.source: che gente è questa, e se tutti fuor cherci
blocks.translation: What people these are, and if all were clerks,

blocks.source: questi chercuti a la sinistra nostra».
blocks.translation: These shaven crowns upon the left of us.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Tutti quanti fuor guerci
blocks.translation: And he to me: “All of them were asquint

blocks.source: sì de la mente in la vita primaia,
blocks.translation: In intellect in the first life, so much

blocks.source: che con misura nullo spendio ferci.
blocks.translation: That there with measure they no spending made.

blocks.source: Assai la voce lor chiaro l’abbaia,
blocks.translation: Clearly enough their voices bark it forth,

blocks.source: quando vegnono a’ due punti del cerchio
blocks.translation: Whene’er they reach the two points of the circle,

blocks.source: dove colpa contraria li dispaia.
blocks.translation: Where sunders them the opposite defect.

blocks.source: Questi fuor cherci, che non han coperchio
blocks.translation: Clerks those were who no hairy covering

blocks.source: piloso al capo, e papi e cardinali,
blocks.translation: Have on the head, and Popes and Cardinals,

blocks.source: in cui usa avarizia il suo soperchio».
blocks.translation: In whom doth Avarice practise its excess.”

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro, tra questi cotali
blocks.translation: And I: “My Master, among such as these

blocks.source: dovre’ io ben riconoscere alcuni
blocks.translation: I ought forsooth to recognise some few,

blocks.source: che furo immondi di cotesti mali».
blocks.translation: Who were infected with these maladies.”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Vano pensiero aduni:
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Vain thought thou entertainest;

blocks.source: la sconoscente vita che i fé sozzi,
blocks.translation: The undiscerning life which made them sordid

blocks.source: ad ogne conoscenza or li fa bruni.
blocks.translation: Now makes them unto all discernment dim.

blocks.source: In etterno verranno a li due cozzi:
blocks.translation: Forever shall they come to these two buttings;

blocks.source: questi resurgeranno del sepulcro
blocks.translation: These from the sepulchre shall rise again

blocks.source: col pugno chiuso, e questi coi crin mozzi.
blocks.translation: With the fist closed, and these with tresses shorn.

blocks.source: Mal dare e mal tener lo mondo pulcro
blocks.translation: Ill giving and ill keeping the fair world

blocks.source: ha tolto loro, e posti a questa zuffa:
blocks.translation: Have ta’en from them, and placed them in this scuffle;

blocks.source: qual ella sia, parole non ci appulcro.
blocks.translation: Whate’er it be, no words adorn I for it.

blocks.source: Or puoi, figliuol, veder la corta buffa
blocks.translation: Now canst thou, Son, behold the transient farce

blocks.source: d’i ben che son commessi a la fortuna,
blocks.translation: Of goods that are committed unto Fortune,

blocks.source: per che l’umana gente si rabbuffa;
blocks.translation: For which the human race each other buffet;

blocks.source: ché tutto l’oro ch’è sotto la luna
blocks.translation: For all the gold that is beneath the moon,

blocks.source: e che già fu, di quest’ anime stanche
blocks.translation: Or ever has been, of these weary souls

blocks.source: non poterebbe farne posare una».
blocks.translation: Could never make a single one repose.”

blocks.source: «Maestro mio», diss’ io, «or mi dì anche:
blocks.translation: “Master,” I said to him, “now tell me also

blocks.source: questa fortuna di che tu mi tocche,
blocks.translation: What is this Fortune which thou speakest of,

blocks.source: che è, che i ben del mondo ha sì tra branche?».
blocks.translation: That has the world’s goods so within its clutches?”

blocks.source: E quelli a me: «Oh creature sciocche,
blocks.translation: And he to me: “O creatures imbecile,

blocks.source: quanta ignoranza è quella che v’offende!
blocks.translation: What ignorance is this which doth beset you?

blocks.source: Or vo’ che tu mia sentenza ne ’mbocche.
blocks.translation: Now will I have thee learn my judgment of her.

blocks.source: Colui lo cui saver tutto trascende,
blocks.translation: He whose omniscience everything transcends

blocks.source: fece li cieli e diè lor chi conduce
blocks.translation: The heavens created, and gave who should guide them,

blocks.source: sì, ch’ogne parte ad ogne parte splende,
blocks.translation: That every part to every part may shine,

blocks.source: distribuendo igualmente la luce.
blocks.translation: Distributing the light in equal measure;

blocks.source: Similemente a li splendor mondani
blocks.translation: He in like manner to the mundane splendours

blocks.source: ordinò general ministra e duce
blocks.translation: Ordained a general ministress and guide,

blocks.source: che permutasse a tempo li ben vani
blocks.translation: That she might change at times the empty treasures

blocks.source: di gente in gente e d’uno in altro sangue,
blocks.translation: From race to race, from one blood to another,

blocks.source: oltre la difension d’i senni umani;
blocks.translation: Beyond resistance of all human wisdom.

blocks.source: per ch’una gente impera e l’altra langue,
blocks.translation: Therefore one people triumphs, and another

blocks.source: seguendo lo giudicio di costei,
blocks.translation: Languishes, in pursuance of her judgment,

blocks.source: che è occulto come in erba l’angue.
blocks.translation: Which hidden is, as in the grass a serpent.

blocks.source: Vostro saver non ha contasto a lei:
blocks.translation: Your knowledge has no counterstand against her;

blocks.source: questa provede, giudica, e persegue
blocks.translation: She makes provision, judges, and pursues

blocks.source: suo regno come il loro li altri dèi.
blocks.translation: Her governance, as theirs the other gods.

blocks.source: Le sue permutazion non hanno triegue:
blocks.translation: Her permutations have not any truce;

blocks.source: necessità la fa esser veloce;
blocks.translation: Necessity makes her precipitate,

blocks.source: sì spesso vien chi vicenda consegue.
blocks.translation: So often cometh who his turn obtains.

blocks.source: Quest’ è colei ch’è tanto posta in croce
blocks.translation: And this is she who is so crucified

blocks.source: pur da color che le dovrien dar lode,
blocks.translation: Even by those who ought to give her praise,

blocks.source: dandole biasmo a torto e mala voce;
blocks.translation: Giving her blame amiss, and bad repute.

blocks.source: ma ella s’è beata e ciò non ode:
blocks.translation: But she is blissful, and she hears it not;

blocks.source: con l’altre prime creature lieta
blocks.translation: Among the other primal creatures gladsome

blocks.source: volve sua spera e beata si gode.
blocks.translation: She turns her sphere, and blissful she rejoices.

blocks.source: Or discendiamo omai a maggior pieta;
blocks.translation: Let us descend now unto greater woe;

blocks.source: già ogne stella cade che saliva
blocks.translation: Already sinks each star that was ascending

blocks.source: quand’ io mi mossi, e ’l troppo star si vieta».
blocks.translation: When I set out, and loitering is forbidden.”

blocks.source: Noi ricidemmo il cerchio a l’altra riva
blocks.translation: We crossed the circle to the other bank,

blocks.source: sovr’ una fonte che bolle e riversa
blocks.translation: Near to a fount that boils, and pours itself

blocks.source: per un fossato che da lei deriva.
blocks.translation: Along a gully that runs out of it.

blocks.source: L’acqua era buia assai più che persa;
blocks.translation: The water was more sombre far than perse;

blocks.source: e noi, in compagnia de l’onde bige,
blocks.translation: And we, in company with the dusky waves,

blocks.source: intrammo giù per una via diversa.
blocks.translation: Made entrance downward by a path uncouth.

blocks.source: In la palude va c’ha nome Stige
blocks.translation: A marsh it makes, which has the name of Styx,

blocks.source: questo tristo ruscel, quand’ è disceso
blocks.translation: This tristful brooklet, when it has descended

blocks.source: al piè de le maligne piagge grige.
blocks.translation: Down to the foot of the malign gray shores.

blocks.source: E io, che di mirare stava inteso,
blocks.translation: And I, who stood intent upon beholding,

blocks.source: vidi genti fangose in quel pantano,
blocks.translation: Saw people mud-besprent in that lagoon,

blocks.source: ignude tutte, con sembiante offeso.
blocks.translation: All of them naked and with angry look.

blocks.source: Queste si percotean non pur con mano,
blocks.translation: They smote each other not alone with hands,

blocks.source: ma con la testa e col petto e coi piedi,
blocks.translation: But with the head and with the breast and feet,

blocks.source: troncandosi co’ denti a brano a brano.
blocks.translation: Tearing each other piecemeal with their teeth.

blocks.source: Lo buon maestro disse: «Figlio, or vedi
blocks.translation: Said the good Master: “Son, thou now beholdest

blocks.source: l’anime di color cui vinse l’ira;
blocks.translation: The souls of those whom anger overcame;

blocks.source: e anche vo’ che tu per certo credi
blocks.translation: And likewise I would have thee know for certain

blocks.source: che sotto l’acqua è gente che sospira,
blocks.translation: Beneath the water people are who sigh

blocks.source: e fanno pullular quest’ acqua al summo,
blocks.translation: And make this water bubble at the surface,

blocks.source: come l’occhio ti dice, u’ che s’aggira.
blocks.translation: As the eye tells thee wheresoe’er it turns.

blocks.source: Fitti nel limo dicon: “Tristi fummo
blocks.translation: Fixed in the mire they say, ‘We sullen were

blocks.source: ne l’aere dolce che dal sol s’allegra,
blocks.translation: In the sweet air, which by the sun is gladdened,

blocks.source: portando dentro accidïoso fummo:
blocks.translation: Bearing within ourselves the sluggish reek;

blocks.source: or ci attristiam ne la belletta negra”.
blocks.translation: Now we are sullen in this sable mire.’

blocks.source: Quest’ inno si gorgoglian ne la strozza,
blocks.translation: This hymn do they keep gurgling in their throats,

blocks.source: ché dir nol posson con parola integra».
blocks.translation: For with unbroken words they cannot say it.”

blocks.source: Così girammo de la lorda pozza
blocks.translation: Thus we went circling round the filthy fen

blocks.source: grand’ arco tra la ripa secca e ’l mézzo,
blocks.translation: A great arc ’twixt the dry bank and the swamp,

blocks.source: con li occhi vòlti a chi del fango ingozza.
blocks.translation: With eyes turned unto those who gorge the mire;

blocks.source: Venimmo al piè d’una torre al da sezzo.
blocks.translation: Unto the foot of a tower we came at last.
